svg.aria-label: The ten stages of academic-pipeline 3.13.0 as boxes in order, each beside the Ordo skills whose roadmap entry names that work, a dashed box being a skill not yet built: Stage 1 RESEARCH beside researcher, paper; Stage 2 WRITE beside paper; Stage 2.5 INTEGRITY beside researcher; Stage 3 REVIEW beside paper-review, referee; Stage 4 REVISE beside paper, rebuttal; Stage 3' RE-REVIEW beside paper-review; Stage 4' RE-REVISE beside paper; Stage 4.5 FINAL INTEGRITY beside researcher; Stage 5 FINALIZE beside submit-manuscript; Stage 6 PROCESS SUMMARY beside no skill.
